title: Linear-Time FPT Decomposition of Series-Parallel Graphs via Orthogonal Embedding Reduction
topic: Linear-Time FPT Rectilinear Planarity Testing of Series-Parallel Graphs
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present a deterministic, linear-time, fixed-parameter tractable (FPT) algorithm for testing rectilinear planarity of series-parallel (SP) graphs in pure Python. The method reduces the problem to SP recognition and a degree-constraint check, both solvable in $O(|V|+|E|)$ time using a union-find structure \cite{Tarjan_1975_UnionFind}. The algorithm guarantees that an SP graph admits a rectilinear embedding iff its maximum degree does not exceed four, a condition verified by a single pass over the adjacency list. Formal invariants are established for the SP decomposition tree and the degree-constraint propagation. The implementation, available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/python-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261028_110120_linear-time_fpt_rectilinear_pl}, is fully reproducible and accompanied by a unit-test suite that covers canonical SP constructions and random recursive compositions. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/python-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261028_110120_linear-time_fpt_rectilinear_pl}
